text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. firms make move to be part of rebirth.
- (Pro-Israeli) South Lebanon Army (SLA) militiamen return to Jezzine panhandle.
- Host of ministers will take up plight of prisoners detained in Israeli jails.
- Investigations launched into explosion at power plant. Wednesday's explosion had caused power cuts in most parts of Lebanon.
- (SLA commander) Lahd will not allow the Lebanese army into Jizzine.
- Parliament Speaker Berri praises handling of civil unrest threat. The speaker says, however, that use of military suppression a "last resort".
